verdict.rationale: The manual says repositories are cloned by pressing + and providing a URL, and that Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols. SSH key identities can be imported or generated in the app, and offline-available clones are a headline feature. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of cloning over each protocol (SSH and git:// in particular).

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone Git repositories over HTTPS, SSH, or the Git protocol

citations.quote: Press + on the list of repositories and provide a URL pointing to your repository. Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.
Clone repositories making them fully available even when offline.
You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.
